utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center works better for me, but I’d like the supplies list and exact timing as soon as you have them so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia. I’ll send the supplies list and exact timing as soon as I pin them down for Saturday on the front porch, and I really appreciate you planning ahead.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up a few handy helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone else who can swing a hammer or lend a hand, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’m lining up a few helpers now. I’ll send you the supplies list and exact timing so you have the concrete details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Saturday at 9 on the front porch still works, and I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll pass the word along and send anyone handy your way for Saturday at 9. Glad the tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any progress on the helper list for Saturday, Oren? I’m still trying to get enough hands for the porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got a couple folks in mind, but I’m a bit foggy on who’s confirmed. I’ll check and send you any names I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Uli — I’m still lining up a few handy helpers for Saturday’s porch repair drive. If you know anyone else who can swing a hammer or lend a hand, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone I find your way for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the Saturday porch repair drive. I’ll see if I can send anyone your way who’s good with a hammer.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren, that would be a big help. I’ve moved it to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send over the supplies list and timing once I finish lining up the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll keep asking around and send anyone handy your way for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’m still lining up a few more handy helpers for Saturday on the front porch, so keep them coming my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center works for me, but I still need the exact timing and supplies list so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check on the exact timing and supplies list and get it to you as soon as I can.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
